answer: Anti-sybil design with hard costs: treat each identity as planting in a shared garden of attested work that cannot be transplanted. Entry requires a basalt bond that rises with every correlated account, and full emission unlocks only after a crystal record of peer-graded original answers across epochs. Fakes pay compounding stake, never inherit the garden history, and stay emission-capped—so mass sybils burn capital faster than they can earn.
